big_case.notes: Self-represented debtor asking the Chief Justice to stop a district judge from ruling on a bankruptcy appeal while a recusal-mandamus rehearing petition was pending in the Fourth Circuit. Denied in a one-line order by a single Justice with no response, referral or amicus. No stakes beyond the parties.

leakage.notes: Forward cell (run 2026-11-09; event resolved 2026-11-11). Log fully captured: prompt and record reads, the statpack, one corpus query for denied applications, and one web fetch of this application's own Supreme Court docket page on 2026-11-09, two days before the denial; the candidate reports it showed only the Nov 2 submission entry. That is a live read of an open docket, the ordinary forward shape. No retrieved date on or after 2026-11-11 and nothing in the reasoning presupposes the result.
